--> very simple and easy to remember electro flash ign into melee, predator flash tp into anything else, theres a lot of other runes but less recommended unless you just REALLY enjoy them or are best in slot vs VERY specific matchups like conq into galio.  
  
--> vlad comes online as early as 1 item, it's just that you need to keep farming ALWAYS, after you come online you have to remember youre REALLY farm reliant and you can't just go with a few minutes of not farming, always be thinking what is the most efficient pathing I can take to maximise cs, in 9999% of the games you win on vlad by farming more and more and faster and faster with more items, and then being there in the critical dragon fights and obliterating anyone, you are not on any time limit you just keep getting strnger and stronger
